messages:
nina: Opening a tiny PR to refresh the 'hello-dock' quickstart- fix auth examples (env/.env), swap Dockerfile to multi-stage, and add GH Actions secret example. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4502

sam: SG. Can you include a one-liner for local setup (export vs .env) so new devs don't paste tokens?

nina: Yep: added `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...` plus a minimal .env example and note: DO NOT COMMIT.

raj: Please ensure the SDK snippet uses `client.generate()` (current stable). Also add a short troubleshooting line if Docker can't reach localhost on macOS.

nina: Done on both. Dockerfile is multi-stage, non-root runtime, posted as snippet in PR.

ci-bot: Running checks... link-check OK, lint OK, found no secrets in diff.

sam: Tiny nit: add GH Actions secret set example: `echo "$REDWOOD_API_KEY" | gh secret set REDWOOD_API_KEY`

nina: Added that and a 3-line workflow example. Merging after CI green, will cherry-pick to v-next. Ping here for follow-ups. :shipit:
